settings.subheading: You don't need to wait for a new year to start working toward your goals.
settings.description: Homecore is Kris Gethin's 12-week muscle-building Daily Video Trainer, designed to help you train from home or the gym with structure, guidance, and daily motivation.
settings.closing: The challenge gives you a start date, a goal to work toward, and an opportunity to win a prize package that supports your next chapter.

settings.subtext: The participant with the best transformation will receive:

settings.title: Join Gethinverse
settings.text: Challenge entry is included with your membership at no additional cost.

settings.title: Register for the challenge
settings.text: Enter the Homecore Challenge and get ready to start on October 19.

settings.title: Document your starting point
settings.text: Take before photos or record a before video to capture your starting point. Keep documenting your progress so you can see how far you've come.

settings.title: Follow the Homecore trainer
settings.text: Train from home or the gym using the workouts, guidance, and daily videos to build a routine you can stick with.

settings.title: Submit your transformation
settings.text: Submit your before and after photos (or videos) as directed to be considered for the prize package. Use the same format for your before and after submissions so your progress can be compared clearly.

settings.note_text: To be eligible to win, you must give permission for your submitted before and after photos or videos to be used for marketing.

settings.question: When does the challenge start?
settings.answer: The Homecore Challenge starts Monday October 19, 2026.

settings.question: How much does it cost to enter?
settings.answer: Entry is free with a Gethinverse membership. Membership fees apply; there is no additional challenge entry fee.

settings.question: Can I do Homecore from home or the gym?
settings.answer: Either. Homecore gives you the flexibility to train from home or the gym. Review the program's equipment requirements before you begin.

settings.question: What can I win?
settings.answer: The best transformation wins six months of VIP coaching with Kris Gethin, supplement stacks from Unmatched Supps and BioStack Labs, a GASP / Better Bodies gift card, a free box of food from Nutrition Solutions, and additional prizes to be announced.

settings.question: Can I submit a before video instead of photos?
settings.answer: Yes. You can document your starting point with before photos or a before video. Use the same format for your after submission to clearly show your transformation.

settings.question: Do I need to submit before and after content to win?
settings.answer: Yes. Before and after photos or videos are required to be considered for the best transformation prize. Make sure you follow the instructions provided.

settings.question: Will my photos or videos be used for marketing?
settings.answer: To be eligible to win, you must allow your submitted before and after photos or videos to be used for marketing. Review the full consent details when registering.
